title: Rule-Based Ensembles
text: rbe implementation RuleFit model Friedman Popescu (2008) uses modern boosting methods XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost. model two parts: boosted tree generates set rules, logical statements describe variables used get terminal nodes tree. regularized generalized linear model takes original predictors well large set binary indicators generated rule set.

title: Rule-Based Ensembles
text: example fits RuleFit model predict delivery times. rules made xgboost:
code: library(rbe) set.seed(273) in_train <-    modeldata::deliveries |>    nrow() |>    sample.int(8000)  delivery_train <- modeldata::deliveries[in_train, ] delivery_test <- modeldata::deliveries[-in_train, ] set.seed(871) rf_fit <- rule_ensemble(time_to_delivery ~ ., data = delivery_train, method = "xgboost") rf_fit #> RuleFit Using XGBoost #>  #> Training Set: #> ℹ Samples: 8000 #>  #> ℹ Predictors: 30 #>  #> ℹ Rules: 222 #>  #>  #> Arguments: #> • trees: 50 #>  #> • mtry: 1 #>  #> • learn_rate: 0.01 #>  #> • tree_depth: 4 #>  #> • min_n: 5 #>  #> • penalty: 0.001 #>  #> • mixture: 1 #>  #> • verbose: FALSE #>  #> • counts: FALSE  rf_pred <-    predict(rf_fit, new_data = delivery_test) |>    dplyr::bind_cols(delivery_test) library(ggplot2)  rf_pred |>    ggplot(aes(.pred, time_to_delivery)) +    geom_abline(col = "green") +    geom_point(alpha = 2 / 3) +   theme_bw()

title: RuleFit Model Objects — rule_ensemble-object
text: first class specific boosting library followed "rule_ensemble", "hardhat_model", "hardhat_scalar". first class "rule_ensemble_xgb", "rule_ensemble_lgb", "rule_ensemble_ctb" xgboost, lightgbm, catboost, respectively. Methods predict(), tidy(), multi_predict() defined "rule_ensemble" class.

title: RuleFit Model Objects — rule_ensemble-object
text: rules: tibble (rule_set object lorax package) one row per rule retained glmnet model. Rules single unique value training set, linear combinations columns, removed. columns : tree: integer index tree rule came . rules: list column R expressions define rule (e.g., wt <= 2.26 & qsec <= 19.17). Use show_rule() print one. id: integer identifier tree node defines rule. label: character column rule names (e.g., "rule_01"). column names rule indicators glmnet model. labels made rules removed, may consecutive. fit: parsnip model_fit object glmnet model. predictors original predictors (indicator columns factors) one 0/1 column per rule. numeric outcome uses parsnip::linear_reg(), factor two levels uses parsnip::logistic_reg(), factor levels uses parsnip::multinom_reg(). arguments: named list values used fit model. contains main arguments (trees, mtry, learn_rate, tree_depth, min_n, penalty, mixture, verbose) followed boosting glmnet options. min_n included catboost models. blueprint: hardhat blueprint used process new data hardhat::forge(). type depends type x used fit model (data frame, matrix, formula, recipe). training: list information training set: rows: number rows used fit glmnet model. lightgbm, rows missing values predictor rule columns removed first. ptype: zero-row data frame processed predictors, character columns converted factors. used make indicator columns new data. weights: NULL case weights used. Otherwise, type case weights: "frequency", "importance", "numeric" (plain numeric vector).

title: Fit a RuleFit Model — rule_ensemble
text: x Depending context: data frame predictors. matrix predictors. formula specifying outcome terms left-hand side, predictor terms right-hand side. recipe specifying set preprocessing steps created recipes::recipe(). ... arguments passed function chosen method: outcome y (data frame matrix x), data (formula recipe x). weights, case weights (used recipe; see "Case weights" section). Named options boosting model glmnet model; see "Boosting glmnet options" section. method single character string boosting library: "xgboost" (default) uses rule_ensemble_xgb(), "lightgbm" uses rule_ensemble_lgb(), "catboost" uses rule_ensemble_ctb(). trees integer number trees contained ensemble. mtry proportion predictors randomly sampled, (0, 1]. xgboost lightgbm, predictors sampled split. catboost, sampled tree level (catboost's rsm). learn_rate number rate boosting algorithm adapts iteration--iteration (specific engines ). sometimes referred shrinkage parameter. tree_depth integer maximum depth tree (.e. number splits) (specific engines ). min_n minimum number data points node needed split (min_child_weight xgboost min_data_in_leaf lightgbm). catboost use min_n; see Details. penalty non-negative number representing total amount regularization (specific engines ). mixture number zero one (inclusive) denoting proportion L1 regularization (.e. lasso) model. mixture = 1 specifies pure lasso model, mixture = 0  specifies ridge regression model, 0 < mixture < 1 specifies elastic net model, interpolating lasso ridge. Available specific engines . verbose single logical. TRUE, boosting library prints training log, rule_ensemble_ctb() warns min_n given ignored.
